description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigHandler class within the Drupal views_ui module, specifically for handling AJAX form configuration of view items in the Drupal CMS. It includes methods for building, validating, submitting, and removing view item configurations, and interacts with various Drupal services and view components.

classes.name: ConfigHandler
classes.description: A class providing AJAX form handling for configuring view items within Drupal's Views UI, including methods for form building, validation, submission, and item removal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ConfigHandler object with optional type and id parameters.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Builds and returns the form for a specific view, display, and item type.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the AJAX form for configuring a view item, including handling relationships and display options.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form options using the handler's validation method and triggers rerender if errors exist.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Processes form submission, updates the view handler options, and caches the changes.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles the removal of a view item and updates the view cache accordingly.
